unsupported: Campofrio Food Group America operates from South Chesterfield, Virginia, as the U.S. arm of Sigma Foods, a multinational food company owned by the Mexican conglomerate ALFA.
Campofrio Food Group America serves the food manufacturing and consumer packaged goods sectors, supplying retail, foodservice, and industrial channels.
Its U.S. presence was strengthened in April 2026 with the acquisition of Roger Wood, a move that expanded its brand portfolio in the American market.
Customers range from global retailers to local distributors seeking branded and private-label meat and dairy products.
